faults.testName: failed compile has scoped diagnostics, no outputs and no uploader invocation despite older successful files
faults.oracle: Earlier binaries are historical; a failed compile creates no selectable output or upload.

faults.testName: dirty user buffer and provider disk edit preserve both and refuse source mutation
faults.oracle: Dirty user text and saved provider bytes survive Keep/Revert conflict.

faults.testName: stale revision or source hash refuses planning and conflicting saved edits are preserved
faults.oracle: Revision/hash conflicts reject stale electrical intent before writing.

faults.testName: board options, source and locally edited library contents change complete build identity
faults.oracle: Library-only changes invalidate complete input fingerprint.

faults.testName: upload waits for actual close, excludes concurrent opens/uploads and resumes one stream
faults.oracle: Uploader begins only after observed close; aliases cannot obtain a second lease.

faults.testName: external contention and unexpected disconnect remain blocked with no synthetic success
faults.oracle: Contention is explicit and never kills or claims control of an external owner.

faults.testName: AC-D19-03: real owning-process loss leaves one unknown receipt and never replays its synthetic effect
faults.oracle: Actual child-process kill leaves the synthetic effect exactly once and an immutable unknown receipt.

faults.testName: disk failure retains earlier complete raw records and labels partial evidence
faults.oracle: Injected storage failure preserves complete prior bytes and marks incomplete capture.

faults.testName: restart retains unknown outcome and identical start does not replay a prompt
faults.oracle: Restart/reconcile does not resubmit a prompt or duplicate tool effects.

faults.testName: native expected-hash race preserves external source and every staged immutable proposal
faults.oracle: External native file save is retained and divergent generation fails without overwrite.

faults.testName: task11.journey.persistent: ordinary source, evidence, both normalized providers and portable recovery share one project
faults.oracle: Restored recording/derivation/citation/review/artifacts remain exact with no device and unknown physical claims.

faults.testName: FTS searches literal Unicode terms, explicit attachment/component filters, and never interpret document instructions
faults.oracle: Instructions embedded in document text remain retrievable evidence and never launch tools.

limitations: Normalized provider, CLI and serial fixtures establish deterministic application behavior, not upstream compatibility or USB/physical results.
Cross-window refusal on the installed VSIX and actual external serial contention require separate packaged/real-hardware evidence.
Native KiCad/CAD reopening and live provider journeys require their separate selected-version probes.
Physical unplug/replug, wiring measurements, Windows screen-reader use and sustained performance are separate release checks.
